# meshoptimizer

Vendored from https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer.

Files are copied from upstream `src/` for native mesh optimization:

- `meshoptimizer.h`
- `allocator.cpp`
- `indexanalyzer.cpp`
- `spatialorder.cpp`
- `vcacheoptimizer.cpp`
- `overdrawoptimizer.cpp`
- `rasterizer.cpp`
- `vfetchoptimizer.cpp`
- `simplifier.cpp`

meshoptimizer is MIT licensed; preserve the upstream notice in source
distributions.
